versions.changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive learning reference for ant-design-vue v4 (Vue 3) components.

- Covers every ant-design-vue v4 component with purpose, variants, runnable SFC example, key props/events/slots, and usage tips.
- Highlights Vue 3 idioms and differences from React antd.
- Organized by component category for quick lookup.
- Includes conventions, best practices, and a Vite-based quickstart for running examples.
- References official documentation and offers guidance for porting from React and building in Slidev.
